# Context

> Compact context-window usage with an automatically derived token graph and anchored detail inspector.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `context` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/context.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/context.md`.

- `lucide-react@^1.47.0`

## Composition

### Context inspector

Omitting children uses the built-in trigger and content. Add a header when composing a custom inspector; ContextBody scrolls under it. ContextLegend derives one row per segment; pass ContextLegendItem children to write the rows yourself.

```tsx
<Context>
  <ContextTrigger />
  <ContextContent>
    <ContextHeader>
      <ContextTitle />
      <ContextDescription />
      <ContextClose />
    </ContextHeader>
    <ContextBody>
      <ContextSummary />
      <ContextGraph />
      <ContextLegend>
        <ContextLegendItem />
      </ContextLegend>
    </ContextBody>
  </ContextContent>
</Context>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import {
  Context,
  ContextBody,
  ContextContent,
  ContextGraph,
  ContextHeader,
  ContextLegend,
  ContextLegendItem,
  ContextSummary,
  ContextTrigger,
} from "@/components/control-ui/context";
import type { ContextSegment } from "@/components/control-ui/context-model";

const segments = [
  { id: "system", label: "System prompt", tokens: 12_000, kind: "system" },
  { id: "tools", label: "Tools", tokens: 18_000, kind: "tool" },
  { id: "messages", label: "Messages", tokens: 52_000, kind: "message" },
  { id: "sources", label: "Sources", tokens: 8_000, kind: "source" },
  { id: "reasoning", label: "Reasoning", tokens: 10_000, kind: "reasoning" },
] satisfies ContextSegment[];

export function ContextExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-40 w-full items-center justify-center">
      <Context segments={segments} maxTokens={200_000} model="GPT-5" locale="en-US" />
    </div>
  );
}

export function ContextComposedExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-40 w-full items-center justify-center">
      <Context segments={segments} maxTokens={200_000} model="GPT-5" locale="en-US">
        <ContextTrigger />
        <ContextContent>
          <ContextHeader />
          <ContextBody>
            <ContextSummary />
            <ContextGraph />
            <ContextLegend>
              <ContextLegendItem
                kind="message"
                label="Conversation"
                description="Messages and reasoning from this thread"
                value="62,000 tokens"
              />
              <ContextLegendItem
                kind="tool"
                label="Instructions and tools"
                description="System prompt and 14 tool definitions"
                value="30,000 tokens"
              />
              <ContextLegendItem kind="source" label="Sources" description="3 attached files" value="8,000 tokens" />
              <ContextLegendItem tone="available" label="Free before compaction" value="100,000 tokens" />
            </ContextLegend>
          </ContextBody>
        </ContextContent>
      </Context>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### context

- `--cui-context-graph-radius`: `9999px`
- `--cui-context-legend-indicator-radius`: `9999px`
- `--cui-context-segment-system-fill`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.75)`
- `--cui-context-segment-cache-fill`: `oklch(from var(--muted-foreground) l c h / 0.55)`
- `--cui-context-track-fill`: `var(--muted)`
- `--cui-context-segment-tool-fill`: `var(--primary)`
- `--cui-context-segment-message-fill`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.65)`
- `--cui-context-segment-source-fill`: `oklch(from var(--accent-foreground) l c h / 0.65)`
- `--cui-context-segment-reasoning-fill`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.5)`
- `--cui-context-overage-fill`: `oklch(from var(--destructive-text) l c h / 0.22)`
- `--cui-context-limit-marker-color`: `var(--destructive-text)`
